DeepBump model shipped in the APK as the asset deepbump256-int8.onnx, a modified version of DeepBump's
deepbump256.onnx, for the relief maps the game makes on the device (src/libs/relief).

Source:    https://github.com/HugoTini/DeepBump
Commit:    fad19ba87daed12b1d0410a57e74f3d79e82f78d (2025-03-17)
Archive:   https://codeload.github.com/HugoTini/DeepBump/tar.gz/fad19ba87daed12b1d0410a57e74f3d79e82f78d
           sha256 213f64f9f38811ae67ef4bb16d38d851bb5c8af2efc2e368b445ab809b38262a
File:      deepbump256.onnx, 26706979 bytes,
           sha256 3a2ababc5fa652b19040a0f3d639b71826368e52ad805cf70ffb0e7c96a54d67 (checked at build time)
Licence:   GPL-3.0 (DeepBump-GPL-3.0.txt, the repository's LICENSE, sha256
           3972dc9744f6499f0f9b2dbf76696f2ae7ad8af9b23dde66d6af86c9dfb36986). The repository's readme: "This repo is
           under the GPL license. The training code is currently not available." The model file is part of the
           repository; no separate licence is stated for it.
Training:  per the author's post (hugotini.github.io/deepbump), real-world photogrammetry and procedural materials from
           texturehaven.com and cc0textures.com.
Modified:  by src/libs/relief/model/make_model.py (in the engine's source, GPL-3.0 like it): its upsamplings take
           constant scales and the input any size; weights and activations quantised to int8 (static QDQ,
           per-channel weights, calibrated on procedural textures generated by the script). Result:
           deepbump256-int8.onnx, 7084998 bytes, sha256
           24b0975701c94500a7ecbc1e0927fc0d07803c19310437ddc4b4ca86fe239603 (checked at build time). As a modified
           version of a GPL-3.0 work it is GPL-3.0 too; its source is the original model with make_model.py.
Use:       run with onnxruntime (MIT, onnxruntime-MIT.txt) on the player's device, in the game process.
